answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 62 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an island bet on surviving 62 epochs of grading, and every violet settlement recomputes the cedar schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
